zh.title: 曼谷蘇凡納布機場（BKK）跑道受損 華航CI840改隔日飛高雄
zh.summary: 華航CI840因曼谷蘇凡納布機場跑道受損改隔日出發
body: 華航表示，昨晚CI840曼谷飛往高雄航班因曼谷蘇凡納布機場（BKK）跑道受損影響航機運行；考量高雄機場（KHH）宵禁，航班改至隔日出發。航班準備起飛時，跑道疑似出現大面積凹陷。華航表示，航機經檢查確認安全無虞。
華航表示，航班出發前安排旅客餐飲、住宿與交通接駁。另華航CI160桃園飛往首爾仁川航班，原定上午7時50分起飛，卻延遲數小時。華航指出，機務訊號異常，依標準作業程序進行檢查，以確保飛航安全。

en.title: China Airlines reschedules CI840 after runway damage in Bangkok
en.summary: China Airlines rescheduled CI840 after runway damage; its CI160 flight was also delayed.
body: China Airlines said its CI840 flight from Bangkok to Kaohsiung was moved to the following day after damage to the runway at Bangkok Suvarnabhumi Airport (BKK) affected aircraft operations. The airline said Kaohsiung Airport (KHH)’s curfew was also taken into account. A large depression was suspected on the runway as the flight prepared to take off. China Airlines said the aircraft was inspected and found safe, and that it arranged meals, accommodation and transport for passengers before departure.

Separately, China Airlines said CI160 from Taoyuan to Seoul Incheon was scheduled to depart at 7:50 a.m. but was delayed by several hours. The airline said an abnormal maintenance signal prompted checks under standard operating procedures to ensure flight safety.
